## KaliScriber 0.8.0

Install the `arm64-v8a` APK on most phones (`universal` if unsure). It updates over earlier builds and keeps your meetings and settings.

### New
- **Weekly recap.** The calendar button on the home screen shows the week: the AI's recap written from each meeting's notes (what happened, the decisions with the meeting they were made in, themes, risks and what to follow up), the week's open action items by person, what's due next week, and the meetings themselves. Go back to earlier weeks, share a recap as Markdown or have it read aloud. Turn on **Weekly recap on Fridays** (Settings → Reminders) to get it as a notification at 4 pm on Fridays.
- **Import transcripts from Zoom, Teams, Google Meet and others.** The import button (and Share or Open with) now also takes transcript files: WebVTT from Zoom and Teams, SRT, Teams Word files, and text from Google Meet, Otter and similar. Speakers and times are read from the file, the meeting takes its title and date where the file gives them, and then gets the usual summary, action items, questions, search and Ask.
- **Bookmark with your headphones.** While recording, press play/pause on wired or Bluetooth headphones to mark the moment. The phone buzzes to confirm. Turn it off in Settings → Meeting processing.

### Speed and cost
- **A quick model for background tasks** (Settings → Active services). Choose a smaller, cheaper model, from the same or another provider, for running notes while recording, speaker name suggestions, glossary fixes and the search words for Ask all meetings. Summaries and answers keep your main model. AI usage & cost lists each model separately, so you can see the difference.
